top_signal.title: [FOR HIRE] Looking for Businesses That Need an Appointment Setting & Cold Calling Team
top_signal.summary: Are you a business owner, agency owner, or entrepreneur looking to scale your sales operations without managing callers yourself?   I'm currently looking for clients who need a reliable, experienced appointment-setting and cold-calling team.   I manage a team of professional agents with at least 1 year of appointment-setting experience. My agents are highly fluent in English, confident on the phone, and experienced in engaging prospects and generating qualified leads.    Our Services Include:      B2B and B2C Cold Calling   Appointment Setting   Lead Generation   Lead Qualification   Follow-up Calls   Objection Handling   CRM Management and Call Disposition      Industries We Have Experience In:      Construction and Home Improvement   Travel and Vacation Clubs   Business Development   Customer Service and Sales Campaigns      Why Work With Us?    You won't have to spend your time recruiting, coordinating, and monitoring individual callers. I handle team management, agent performance, quality assurance, and productivity monitoring so you can focus on running and growing your business.   My goal is to help your business generate more qualified opportunities, maintain a consistent sales pipeline, and ultimately increase revenue.   I'm open to working with marketing agencies, contractors, service-based businesses, and companies looking to outsource their outbound sales operations.
